newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Ridley agrees listing of Canadian unit.
newsitem.headline: Ridley agrees listing of Canadian unit.

text.p: Stockfeed producer Ridley Corp Ltd said on Wednesday it has signed agreements with a syndicate to underwrite the initial public offering (IPO) of fully-owned subsidiary Ridley Canada Ltd on the Toronto Stock Exchange.
Under the IPO, Ridley Canada would raise C$65.75 million by the issue of 5.26 million shares at C$12.50 per share.
The underwriters, led by ScotiaMcLeod Inc of Toronto, would also be entitled to the over-allotment of another 263,000 shares, which could raise an extra C$3.29 million.

Ridley, which would retain a 58 percent equity interest in Ridley Canada, said the funds raised from the IPO would be used to retire bridging finance for the US$65 million purchase of Hubbard Milling Co in May.
Ridley Canada, based in Winnipeg, Manitoba was acquired by Australian-based Ridley Corp in June, 1994 and has since expanded into other Canadian provinces.
Its shares were expected to start trading on August 9.
